_source: Model: sight lines over GSI DEM10B elevation tiles (国土地理院, zoom 12), earth curvature with refraction k=0.13, observer 12 m above ground, summit must stand at least 0.4° above the horizon. Ignores trees, buildings, noise barriers and weather. Track: OpenStreetMap contributors (ODbL). Direction of travel: Abashiri → Shiretoko-Shari.
